subject: Demo: Dedicated capacity for Olive.ai — scheduling
messages:
From: Olive.ai - Sales Ops <salesops@olive.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood Dedicated — demo request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — Rebecca from our R&D team just completed a self-serve signup and requested a demo for Redwood Dedicated. They listed throughput and latency as primary concerns and included a short questionnaire (attached). Can you or someone on the SDR team help schedule a 30–45m technical demo?

High-level ask from Rebecca: consistent p95 latency under ~500ms for inference at ~50 concurrent requests, and predictable throughput for 1k-token responses. They want to discuss model pinning and autoscaling policies.

I've attached the signup details and their filled-out requirements.

Attachments: olive-demo-reqs.xlsx

— Sales Ops (Olive.ai)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Rebecca Wu <rebecca.wu@olive.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Dedicated — demo request

Hi Rebecca — thanks for signing up and for the details. I'm Aditya on SDR — happy to coordinate the demo. Quick Qs before we book:

- Is your team primarily concerned about tail latency (p95/p99) for single-request latency, or sustained throughput under load?
- Do you have an internal compliance window (VPC/on-prem) or is hosted Dedicated OK for now?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Aug 5, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Thu Aug 5, 3:00–3:45pm PT
- Mon Aug 9, 11:00–11:45am PT

If none of these work, share a couple of windows and we'll adjust. I'll loop Marissa for technical depth on throughput/quantization guidance.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
calendly: https://calendly.com/aditya-rao/redwood-demo

From: Rebecca Wu <rebecca.wu@olive.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Dedicated — demo request

Hi Aditya — thanks. Good Qs: both, but focus is on predictable p95 latency for 1k-token responses while supporting ~50 concurrent requests during peak. Hosted Dedicated is fine for now; we may evaluate VPC later.

The Thu Aug 5 3:00pm PT slot works for Rebecca and our infra lead (Jonas). Please send a calendar invite and any pre-read. We've attached an architecture diagram and the filled requirements form.

Attachments: olive-architecture.pdf, olive-demo-reqs.xlsx

— Rebecca

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Rebecca Wu <rebecca.wu@olive.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Dedicated — demo request

Thanks Rebecca — confirmed for Thu, Aug 5 at 3:00pm PT. I've invited Redwood's infra lead (Dylan) to cover autoscaling, kernel selection, and latency SLOs. Outline for the session:

1) Quick intro (5m)
2) Requirements walkthrough (10m) — you to confirm target p95 and concurrency patterns
3) Dedicated runtime overview (10m) — autoscaling, quantization, KV/prefix caching
4) Q&A + next steps (20m) — if alignment, propose follow-up load test and pricing/commit guidance

Pre-read: redwood-dedicated-capacity-onepager.pdf (attached).

Calendar invite: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-dedicated-demo (invite sent to Rebecca, Jonas). I’ll also prepare a short latency/throughput table drawing from similar customers so we can be concrete in the demo.

If you have any specific sample prompts or token-length distributions, please send them over so we can tailor the demo load test.

Best,
